proof_body:
by
  intro m a b v
  have h1 : (fun x : ℝ => a * x + b) = (fun x => x + b) ∘ (fun x => a * x) := rfl
  rw [h1, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_const_mul, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_add_const]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp [sq_nonneg]
target_source: ∀ (m a b : ℝ) (v : NNReal), (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v).map (fun x => a * x + b) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (a * m + b) (Real.toNNReal (a ^ 2) * v)
